info.title: GodotXaml.Cli
info.description: Checks, converts and formats Godot scenes and resources written as XAML.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Parses .xscn and .xres files and reports every problem found.

options.name: --metadata
options.description: The Godot metadata file; default, the metadata/godot-4.7.json shipped beside the tool.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A .xscn or .xres file, or a folder searched recursively for both.

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Converts .tscn and .tres files to .xscn and .xres, and back, writing each beside its source.

options.name: --metadata
options.description: The Godot metadata file; default, the metadata/godot-4.7.json shipped beside the tool.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrites an output that already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --project
options.description: A Godot project's root folder: converts every .tscn and .tres under it, or nothing if one fails, edits the scripts and project.godot that name them, and removes the originals after backing them up.

options.name: --back
options.description: With --project, converts every .xscn and .xres back to .tscn and .tres. [default: False]

options.name: --nobackup
options.description: Deletes the originals with no backup. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A .tscn, .tres, .xscn or .xres file, or a folder searched recursively for all four.

commands.name: format
commands.description: Rewrites .xscn and .xres files in place in the canonical layout.

options.name: --metadata
options.description: The Godot metadata file; default, the metadata/godot-4.7.json shipped beside the tool.

options.name: --check
options.description: Changes nothing; names each file that would change, and exits 1 when any would. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A .xscn or .xres file, or a folder searched recursively for both.
